en: The front of the postcard features three black-and-white photographic views. The top left image shows a neoclassical building with people gathered in front, labeled as 'Военния клубъ' (Military Club). The top right shows an obelisk-monument in a square, with chains surrounding its base. The bottom image shows another square with crowds and a prominent building, labeled 'Градско Общинско Управление' (City Municipal Administration). There is handwriting and postal stamps as well. The back of the postcard contains text in Bulgarian, postal marks, and official stamps. The overall look suggests the document originates from the early 20th century.
